name: Bright loft with tall windows
description: Spacious empty loft with a honey oak strip floor, white walls, thin black baseboards, and a flat white ceiling. Two tall black-framed grid windows sit in deep reveals on the west long wall. The east wall jogs into the room along its south run and opens into a northeast alcove. A 36 by 80 inch door is on the south wall.
origin: interior floor center (0, 0, 0); floor top is Z=0

main_bay_m.note: Rectangle west of the jog, before the alcove is added.

walls.Wall_Jog: east wall jog, interior face at X=JOG_X, from the south wall to the alcove
walls.Wall_Return: south side of the northeast alcove

jog.note: The east wall steps west into the room from the south wall up to the return, leaving a 4 ft by 10 ft alcove in the northeast.

free_floor.note: Walkable floor at Z=0. Vertices in order around the interior footprint. X is east, Y is north. The jog wall (thickness 0.12 m east of JOG_X, south of JOG_Y) is not floor. Primary seating fits in the main bay, clear of the south door.

TV_wall.note: Floor anchor on the blank north wall, centered in the main bay. Yaw 0 so a TV's front (local -Y) faces into the room. Raise Z to wall-mount the screen.

Sofa_spot.note: Floor anchor for a sofa in the main bay. Yaw 180 so its front (local -Y) faces TV_wall.

Rug_center.note: Center of the seating rug between the sofa and the coffee table. Yaw 0 lays an 8x10 carpet with its long side along Y.

Coffee_spot.note: Floor anchor for a coffee table between the sofa and the north wall. Yaw 0.

Plant_corner.note: Northwest corner, beside the blank wall and clear of the far window. Yaw 0.

Lamp_corner.note: Southwest corner for a floor lamp, west of the door. Yaw 0.

Alcove_spot.note: Center of the northeast alcove. Yaw -90 so a chair or lamp front (local -Y) faces west into the main room.
